thread:
marta: Heads up — product wants to export a week-long SIEM snapshot for a third‑party vendor review. They asked what entitlements we should grant and how to avoid widening KMS unwrap scope. Any quick patterns?
kevin: Short answer: don’t give them broad SIEM read or main CMK Decrypt. Create an export-specific flow: ephemeral snapshot S3 prefix, an export-only CMK or grant, and a time-limited proxy role.
leila: Compliance: vendor copies allowed but retention capped at 90 days and must have a signed DPA + approved justification ticket. Also require minimal selectors (no PII unless explicitly approved).
sam: From oncall POV — we currently do JIT for internal analysts for 48h during incidents. Can we reuse the same JIT pattern for vendor exports? How do we revoke fast if something goes sideways?
marta: Proposed flow: 1) spin up export snapshot to a dedicated S3 prefix 2) SSE-KMS with an export CMK or a grant scoped via EncryptionContext 3) create a short-lived IAM role (assume-role with STS, duration limited) that the export-proxy uses to read the prefix 4) log every KMS Decrypt and S3 GET in CT and alert. This prevents giving vendor broad decrypt on our primary keys. :thumbsup:
kevin: Example grant/command we use for export proxy (replace values):
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/EXPORT-CMK-XYZ \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/export-proxy-role \
  --operations Decrypt \
  --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset":{"export":"siem-snapshot","request":"EXPORT-12345"}}'
```
kevin: Then create a role with a trust policy limited to our export service and allow S3:GetObject on only the export prefix. Make the role assumable only after an approval ticket and for max 1h.
marta: Also: enforce that exported objects include a metadata tag `export:siem-snapshot` and the entire flow emits a CloudTrail event with that context. audit-bot will pick that up and escalate if Decrypts occur outside expected window.
audit-bot: ALERT RULE: cloudtrail.KMSDecrypt where encryptionContext.export exists -> create ticket:sec-export-review, severity:high, notify:#eng-security.
leila: We’ll add a vendor-export checklist: vendor name, data selectors (query), retention days, legal sign-off, contact, and approved timeframe. Also require a signed ack that no retention beyond approved window.
sam: One more question — can we actively revoke a grant? I remember grants can't always be deleted.
kevin: Good catch. If you create grants without a grant token you can retire them only if you have the grant token or you issued them from a KMS key that you can disable. Pragmatic approach: don’t rely on deleting grants; instead use short-lived STS creds for the role + remove role trust or detach the role policy to immediately cut access. Also rotate the export CMK or disable it in extreme cases.
marta: Action items: kevin - draft the AWS example + Terraform snippet for export role and key policy; leila - add vendor ticket template and retention approvals; sam - add a runbook for emergency revocation and test a revoke drill next oncall cycle.
kevin: Will do. I'll post a PR for the TF module and a short playbook for the revoke steps.
leila: I'll mock the ticket template and circulate for legal.
sam: I’ll schedule the drill and include scenario where vendor keys leaked.
marta: Thanks team. If anyone wants to shadow the TF PR review ping me. :eyes:
